title: Color Selector
content: Build color variant selector with swatches. Layout: horizontal row of color swatches. Swatch: w-8 h-8 rounded-full, actual color as background. Selected state: ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-black. Hover: scale-110, show color name tooltip. Color name: display selected color as text label. Availability: dim unavailable colors. Image change: selecting color changes product gallery images.

variants.simple: Create color swatches that show selected color name and update product images.
variants.detailed: Build color variant selector with swatches. Layout: horizontal row of color swatches. Swatch: w-8 h-8 rounded-full, actual color as background. Selected state: ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-black. Hover: scale-110, show color name tooltip. Color name: display selected color as text label. Availability: dim unavailable colors. Image change: selecting color changes product gallery images.
variants.advanced: Build color variant selector with swatches and image synchronization. Layout: vertical section with "Color: [Selected Color Name]" label and swatch row. Swatch container: flex flex-wrap gap-3 for swatch buttons. Swatch button: w-8 h-8 rounded-full, actual color as background using inline style or Tailwind arbitrary value, border for light colors (border border-gray-200). For white/cream: add subtle border so it's visible. Selected state: ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-black, slightly larger scale-110. Hover: scale-110 transform transition-transform, show tooltip with color name below or above swatch. Color name display: "Color: Navy Blue" text above swatches showing currently selected, update on selection. Availability per swatch: available (normal appearance), low stock (small badge or pulsing dot), out of stock (opacity-50 with diagonal line overlay using ::after or X icon overlay, cursor-not-allowed). Tooltip on unavailable: "Currently unavailable" message. Pattern swatches: for patterned variants (stripes, floral), show small pattern image (bg-cover) instead of solid color. Large swatches variant: for fewer colors (3-4), show larger circles (w-10 h-10) with color name label below each. Image synchronization: selecting color updates product gallery to show that color variant, smooth transition. If color affects price, show price difference on hover. Low stock warning: when selecting a low-stock color, show "Only 2 left in Blue" message below selector. Combined display: inline "Color: " with small swatch circle next to selected name text. Accessibility: ensure color name is programmatically available (aria-label on button), not just visual color representation. Use aria-checked for selection state. Keyboard: arrow keys to navigate between swatches when focused. Screen reader: announce "Navy Blue, In Stock" on focus.
